invalidation_condition: Market closes PPI above consensus (+0.3%) but DXY stays flat or declines; or if equity futures gap higher (risk-on overrides inflation concern)
stage_reason: PPI MoM +0.3% reacceleration and Core PPI MoM +0.2% reversal trigger immediate hawkish repricing. USD strength on inflation surprise drives initial UP momentum. DXY likely rises; higher real rates support carry unwind vs JPY short-term.

invalidation_condition: If Treasury curve flattens sharply (10Y yield drops while 2Y rises) or if equity volatility spikes, reversal begins early
stage_reason: Sustained hawkish momentum persists as market digests dual MoM acceleration. Fed rate path reprices higher; 2Y yields climb. DXY momentum carries through. However, by 15min, mean reversion risk builds as traders lock profits and reassess growth implications of higher rates.

invalidation_condition: If DXY continues climbing or equities rally, UP resumes past 30min. If Powell communications due later imply patience, reversal accelerates DOWN.
stage_reason: Reversal zone: Market reprices Fed policy tightening, recognizing growth risks. If risk sentiment deteriorates (equities weaken), safe-haven JPY demand emerges; USD bulls exhaust. Consolidation and churn expected. Direction pivots on whether rate-hike anxiety (DOWN/JPY strength) or inflation persistence (UP/USD) dominates.

invalidation_condition: If Treasury yields stabilize at higher levels (no 10Y breakdown), or if Fed speakers affirm patience post-release, DOWN reversal stalls and FLAT/consolidation extends
stage_reason: By 60min, rate hike repricing fatigue and growth concern dominate. Risk-off bias likely; safe-haven JPY accumulation if equity tone sours. Inflation surprise yields to policy impact fears. Down move reflects carry unwind and JPY safe-haven demand, though volatility and choppy structure persist.
